evals.name: first-time-bootstrap
evals.prompt: Acabei de clonar o repositório AI Customer Support no Windows. Como configuro o ambiente e subo a API?
assertions: Mentions bootstrap.ps1 or equivalent uv sync + docker compose steps
Uses database port 5433 for local host
Mentions fastapi dev or fastapi run

evals.name: postgres-auth-failed
evals.prompt: Alembic falha com password authentication failed for user postgres em localhost:5432. O que fazer?
assertions: Identifies port conflict with local PostgreSQL

evals.name: checkpointer-startup-error
evals.prompt: fastapi dev falha no startup: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block. Como corrigir?
assertions: Points to LangGraph checkpointer setup in workflow.py

evals.name: portal-greenlet-spawn
evals.prompt: No portal, ao enviar a primeira mensagem em Como podemos ajudar hoje?, a UI mostra {"detail":"Internal server error","error":"greenlet_spawn has not been called; can't call await_only() here."}. O que é e como corrigir?
assertions: Points to POST /portal/conversations or ticket_to_response after flush
Recommends get_ticket_or_404 or selectinload before serializing

evals.name: assistant-reply-vanishes
evals.prompt: No chat do portal o assistente responde, a mensagem aparece cerca de um segundo e some. Só volta se eu recarregar o navegador. Como corrigir sem inventar WebSockets?
assertions: Mentions use-chat-stream or SSE leftover/CRLF parser or done.answer
Warns against resetting messages from stale initialMessages
Mentions Redis get_message timeout or not wait_for on listen if discussing /events
